title: The Dangers of Non-Self-Fixed Architecture Technical Debt and Its Impact on Time-to-Fix
abstract: arXiv:2605.16133v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Technical Debt (TD) refers to the long-term costs incurred when developers prioritize short-term delivery over quality-improving work. Architectural Technical Debt (ATD) arises when architectural decisions (e.g., technology choices, patterns, or decomposition) prioritize near-term progress over future maintainability and evolvability. Because ATD affects a system's core structure and propagates through architectural dependencies, it is often more expensive and disruptive to remediate than localized code-level debt. Although ATD has been widely studied, an important but underexplored aspect of repayment is who performs it. Prior work provides limited empirical evidence on repayment responsibility in ATD and its relationship to time-to-fix. We empirically study self-fixed ATD, where the introducer also repays the debt, and contrast it with non--self-fixed ATD in large Apache open-source projects. We reconstruct ATD lifecycles by tracin

translated_title: 非自修复架构技术债的危害及其对修复时间的影响
translated_abstract: 技术债是指开发者在优先考虑短期交付而非质量改进工作时所产生的长期成本。当架构决策（如技术选型、设计模式或系统分解方式）优先考虑近期进展而牺牲未来的可维护性和可演化性时，便产生了架构技术债。由于架构技术债影响系统的核心结构，并通过架构依赖不断传播，其修复成本往往比局部性的代码级债务更高，破坏性也更大。尽管架构技术债已被广泛研究，但债务偿还中一个重要却未被充分探索的方面是：由谁来偿还。先前的工作在架构技术债偿还责任及其与修复时间的关系方面提供的实证证据有限。我们对自修复架构技术债（即由债务引入者本人偿还债务）进行了实证研究，并在大型Apache开源项目中将其与非自修复架构技术债进行对比。我们通过追踪……（摘要至此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对大型Apache开源项目中架构技术债生命周期的实证分析，发现需要由引入者之外的人偿还的非自修复架构技术债往往导致更长的修复时间，从而揭示了其潜在危害。
en_tdlr: Through empirical analysis of Architectural Technical Debt (ATD) lifecycles in large Apache open-source projects, this study finds that non-self-fixed ATD—repaid by someone other than the introducer—tends to take longer to fix, revealing its inherent dangers.
